en-US.description: League of Legends companion that turns match history into data-driven AI match reviews.
en-US.longDescription:
Rank Analysis is a League of Legends companion built on Riot's official LCU API. Its standout feature is data-driven AI match review: instead of only listing numbers, it quantifies each game and has an AI explain why you won or lost — who carried, who fed, who got stomped, and who was dragged down by teammates. Every verdict is grounded in real data such as KDA, damage and tank share, gold, kill participation, towers, and CS.
Around that core it also covers match-history lookup with win-rate highlighting, premade and teammate-risk detection during lobby or queue, rule-based automatic pick/ban, player notes and tags, and cloud-synced backups.
The app is built with Tauri 2 and ships as a single native binary. It reads live game state through the LCU WebSocket and fetches history over local HTTP: no DLL injection and no game memory access.

zh-CN.author: wnzzer
zh-CN.description: 基于 Riot 官方 LCU API 的英雄联盟助手，用数据驱动的 AI 复盘每一局对局。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Rank Analysis 是一个基于 Riot 官方 LCU API 的英雄联盟助手。它最大的亮点是数据驱动的 AI 对局复盘：不止给你堆数字，而是把每一局量化后让 AI 讲清楚你这把为什么赢或输——谁 carry、谁犯罪、谁被打爆、谁被队友拖累。每条结论都建立在 KDA、伤害占比、承伤占比、经济、参团率、推塔、补刀等真实数据上，而非纯主观点评。
围绕这个核心，它也覆盖了基础能力：带高低胜率高亮的战绩查询、组队与排队阶段的队友与对手风险判断、规则化的自动抢锁与 BP、玩家备注与标签，以及云端同步备份。
项目使用 Tauri 2 构建，是单个原生二进制应用。通过 LCU WebSocket 监听实时对局状态，通过本地 HTTP 拉取战绩：不注入 DLL、不读游戏内存。
